headline: 1-7, last place, and a 45.02-point loss
story: Week 8 was a 126.4 to 81.38 loss to Johnny4Skins, with Dalton Kincaid leading at 18.6. Everything on his 26.02-point bench would have started, which is what a thin supporting cast looks like. He stayed 12th at 1-7 with 805.02 points, last in the league.

His 1037.72 MAXPF holds the 1.02, 44.6 above Snipe58. The market feed has him on correction, down 4.5% over 30 days, with 17.3% of his roster's value sidelined, Travis Etienne, Terry McLaurin, Romeo Doubs and Michael Pittman among them. FAAB is an untouched $500, and the move that would help is still a trade.
takes: Every bench point would have started and it still was not enough.
A full wallet and a 1.02 that moves only on a trade.
